step0.label: Step 1/3 · Evidence Sets
step0.title: Evidence Sets = cross-paper evidence collections
step0.body: Group snippets from multiple papers that support the same point — easy to recall, cite, and reuse when writing reviews.

step1.label: Step 2/3 · How to build
step1.title: Build sets from PDFs
step1.body: Go to Library → open a PDF → highlight text → "Add to evidence set". Each piece auto-carries its source.

step2.label: Step 3/3 · Use evidence sets
step2.title: Start a new task → @ mention the evidence set in chat
step2.body: Select an evidence set; the Agent will auto-attach sources when writing reviews / reports.

step0.label: Step 1/2 · Paper notes
step0.title: Note = a lightweight annotation on a paper
step0.body: Anchored to a specific PDF paragraph, jot a quick thought. All notes are also indexed into evidence sets.

step1.label: Step 2/2 · How to create
step1.title: Highlight to create a note
step1.body: Select text in the PDF → click "Save" in the popup.

step0.label: Step 1/3 · Configure
step0.title: Configure an LLM channel first
step0.body: Without an API key the Agent can't run. Click here to open settings.

step1.label: Step 1/3 · Add
step1.title: Click "Add channel" to add one
step1.body: Pick a provider like Anthropic / Kimi / DeepSeek, paste the API key, and create.

step2.label: Step 1/3 · Done
step2.title: Close settings when done
step2.body: Click here to close settings and return to the main view to continue.

step0.label: Step 2/3 · Connect
step0.title: Connect Zotero (optional)
step0.body: When connected, the Agent can read PDFs from your library. You can skip if you don't use Zotero.

step0Connected.label: Step 2/3 · Connected
step0Connected.title: Zotero connected ✓
step0Connected.body: Your library is ready and the Agent can read its PDFs. Click here to open the library.

step1.label: Step 2/3 · Launch
step1.title: Launch Zotero desktop
step1.body: Click here to launch Zotero. Skip this step if Zotero isn't installed or you don't need it.

step0.label: Step 3/3 · Task
step0.title: Create your first task
step0.body: Click here to start a new conversation.

step1.label: Step 3/3 · Starter
step1.title: Try one of these starters
step1.body: Below the mascot are 4 example prompts. Click one to fill the input box and start chatting.

searchProtein.label: Search protein-structure papers
searchProtein.prompt: Search papers on LLMs + protein structure prediction

analyzePdf.label: Analyze this PDF's conclusions
analyzePdf.prompt: Help me analyze the key conclusions of this PDF

importZotero.label: Import Zotero collection
importZotero.prompt: Import my current Zotero collection and organize it

tips.macShortcutNew: Press ⌘N to start a new conversation
tips.macShortcutMode: Press ⌘⇧M to switch between Chat and Agent modes
tips.macShortcutFocus: Press ⌘L to jump to the input box
tips.macShortcutClear: Press ⌘K to clear the current conversation context
tips.macShortcutStop: Press ⌘. to interrupt the AI response
tips.macShortcutClose: Press ⌘W to close the current tab
tips.macShortcutZoom: Press ⌘+ / ⌘- to zoom the UI, ⌘0 to reset
tips.winShortcutNew: Press Ctrl+N to start a new conversation
tips.winShortcutSearch: Press Ctrl+F to search past conversations
tips.winShortcutSidebar: Press Ctrl+B to toggle the sidebar
tips.winShortcutMode: Press Ctrl+Shift+M to switch between Chat and Agent modes
tips.winShortcutFocus: Press Ctrl+L to jump to the input box
tips.winShortcutClear: Press Ctrl+K to clear the current conversation context
tips.winShortcutStop: Press Ctrl+. to interrupt the AI response
tips.winShortcutClose: Press Ctrl+W to close the current tab
tips.winShortcutZoom: Press Ctrl++ / Ctrl+- to zoom the UI, Ctrl+0 to reset
tips.tipAgentFile: Type @ to reference workspace files, Skills, MCP, or Zotero items
tips.tipAttachment: Drag PDF / Office files onto the input to upload as attachments
tips.tipShortcutsCustom: Customize all shortcuts under Settings → Shortcuts
tips.taskSearch: Try "find recent highly-cited papers on XX" — the Agent searches arXiv / PubMed for you
tips.taskReview: Try "draft a structured literature review on XX" — the Agent organizes by IMRaD
tips.taskCompare: Upload two PDFs and ask "compare these two methods and their applicable scenarios"
tips.taskSummarize: Drop a PDF in and ask "summarize the research question, methods, and conclusions"
tips.taskZotero: After connecting Zotero, @ can reference library items so the Agent answers with full context
tips.taskOutline: Try "draft an experiment design and timeline for XX"
